_meta.title: v7p3p4 infer smoke (safe fallback when admissible-progress mask is empty)
_meta.summary: Quick inference-only smoke on a fixed v7p3p2 checkpoint to validate the v7p3p4 safe-fallback patch: when argmax(Q) is inadmissible and no progress-admissible actions exist, fall back to collision-safe actions instead of keeping the original argmax.
notes: Inference-only smoke: runs=3 (short/mid/long). No training in this profile.
This profile expects `infer.models` to point to an existing checkpoint directory (e.g. v7p3p2 smoke).
Key parameters for turn-aware replacement and gating follow the v7p3p2 ablation sweet spot: `forest_topk_turn_penalty=0.3`, `forest_min_progress_m=0.0`.
